text: {"frames":["The windmill on the top floor of the Tower began to turn, though not a single thread of wind stirred in the rooms. Wooden clogs clattered on the stairs below, and a miller's cap lay on the sill, still warm. You climb to the sails and find a brass plate with {a} scratched on one end and {b} on the other. The sails stay stuck until the plate shows the right sign. Which sign must go between {a} and {b} to set the mill turning?","An empty rowing boat drifted along the Tower canal and bumped gently against your clogs. Inside sat a little iron casket with a lock, and a note tied to its handle read: open me with the right sign. You turn the numbers on the lid, {a} and {b}, and the lock clicks but holds fast. Which sign goes between {a} and {b} so the lid springs open?","All the windows of the house with the hoist beam glow gold, yet nobody answers when you knock. The cheese bell that always hung by the door has gone missing, and only its rope is left swinging. Under the beam someone has chalked {a} on the left and {b} on the right, as if waiting for a reply. Which sign must go between {a} and {b} to bring the bell back?","Every night a new shadow appears on the cellar wall, and tonight there is a smell of warm waffles and wet wool. The shadow wears a tall hat and stands beside a row of clogs. Your lantern shows scratches in the stone: {a} and {b}, cut close together. The shadow will only leave the wall when the sign between them is right. Which sign goes between {a} and {b} so the shadow can slip away?","Please help me, said a small voice from the tulip wrapping around an old map. You unroll the map and see a canal that nobody in Misty Ford remembers. At its lock gate two numbers are written, {a} and {b}, and the gate opens only for the right sign. Which sign must go between {a} and {b} to let the water through the old canal?"]}
